_about: Values the Bucket API does not hold, read from wiki pages (owner 2026-09-30: what the API and buckets lack, get with the wiki's own page search). Applied by generate.py (tidy_tasks); each entry names the page it came from. locations: coordinates for a location record (all tasks with that location name unless 'task' is given), replacing missing or instance-only ones so the route and map marker work. monsters: combat stats the monster's bucket row leaves empty.
